summary: Iteration 55 - PO and Invoice Enhanced Features Testing Complete. Backend: 26/26 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All enhanced features verified working including PO approval workflow, PDF download, email vendor, duplicate, notes, spend analytics, and Invoice aging report, revenue analytics, clone, email, credit notes.
critical_code_review_comments: PO List Page: Shows stats (Total, Draft, Ordered, Partial, Total Value), Analytics button, New Purchase Order button, table with Download/Duplicate icons per row - ALL WORKING

PO Detail View: Shows approval pipeline (Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Ordered → Partial → Received), tabbed layout (Items, Notes, Audit Trail), action buttons (Submit for Approval, Submit to Vendor, Download PDF, Email to Vendor, Duplicate PO, Edit, Cancel PO, Delete) - ALL WORKING
PO Spend Analytics: Shows Total Spend, Total POs, Avg PO Value, Top Vendors by Spend, Monthly Spend Trend, Status Breakdown - ALL WORKING
Invoice List Page: Shows stats (Total, Paid, Unpaid, Collected, Outstanding), Aging Report button, Revenue Analytics button, Clone buttons per row - ALL WORKING

Invoice Detail View: Shows Payment Progress bar, tabbed layout (Line Items, Payments, Emails, Audit), action buttons (Pay with Stripe, Record Manual Payment, Preview PDF, Download PDF, Email Invoice, Clone Invoice, Issue Credit Note, Mark as Sent, Move to Client, Edit, Void Invoice, Delete) - ALL WORKING
Aging Report: Shows buckets (1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, Current, 120+ Days) with invoice counts and amounts, Grand Total Outstanding - ALL WORKING
Revenue Analytics: Shows Total Revenue, Total Collected, Outstanding, Collection Rate, MRR, ARR, Monthly Revenue Trend, Top Clients by Revenue - ALL WORKING
Credit Note Dialog: Opens with amount and reason fields - WORKING
Email Invoice Dialog: Opens correctly - WORKING
seed_data_creation: Test POs and Invoices created during backend testing were cleaned up. Existing data: 4 POs (PO-1001 to PO-1004), 8 Invoices
